items.further_additives: None explicitly mentioned, but lysozyme used for cell lysis in lysate experiments. Ethyl acetate used as co-solvent. Heptane used for crystallization. Kanamycin and lactose used in cell culture.
items.ionic_strength_unit: mM (PB buffer in screening; 400 mM NaOCN in scale-up)
items.solvent_description: Aqueous phase: PB buffer (50 mM, pH 7.0) for screening; water for scale-up. Organic phase: ethyl acetate (co-solvent, 35% v/v in reactions, also used for extraction and phase separation). Heptane used for crystallization. Other solvents tested: heptane, n-butanol, toluene, MTBE, dichloromethane.
items.special_treatment: Two-phase system with ethyl acetate to enhance substrate solubility and avoid direct contact of enzyme with substrate. Self-regulated pH control via ethyl acetate hydrolysis. Temperature controlled at 25°C during pilot-scale reactions. Cell lysis with lysozyme for lysate experiments. Centrifugation and phase separation for post-processing. Crystallization with heptane. GC analysis for product quantification. Chiral GC for ee determination. Substrate docking performed with AutoDockVina/Yasara.
